index.title: Custom Indoor Playgrounds, Trnava | PLAYGROUND
index.description: We design, manufacture and install custom indoor playgrounds for family centres, cafés, hotels and nurseries. Rebuilds and inspections. Based in Trnava.

ihriska.title: Custom Indoor Play Areas for Children | PLAYGROUND
ihriska.description: Custom indoor play area for a restaurant, hotel, shopping centre or nursery. Design, 3D visualisation, manufacture and installation to EN 1176 and EN 1177.

prerabka.title: Indoor Playground Rebuild and Relocation | PLAYGROUND
prerabka.description: We rebuild an old indoor playground into a new, certified one, reusing the original structure. We dismantle, transport and install it in a new space too.

revizie.title: Playground Inspection and Service | PLAYGROUND
revizie.description: Annual checks and inspections of indoor playgrounds to EN 1176 and EN 1177. Repairs, replacement of worn parts and spare parts from our stock. Trnava.

realizacie.title: Indoor Playground Projects | PLAYGROUND
realizacie.description: Finished indoor playgrounds, rebuilds and relocations: Trnava, Šamorín, Hlohovec, Pezinok, Oravice and Czech towns. See photos of our completed projects.

o-nas.title: About Us: Indoor Playground Manufacturer | PLAYGROUND
o-nas.description: PLAYGROUND from Trnava has supplied certified indoor playgrounds for 15 years. Over 180 projects in Slovakia and abroad, our own parts stock and service.

kontakt.title: Contact and Playground Enquiry, Trnava | PLAYGROUND
kontakt.description: Send us the dimensions of your space and your idea of the playground, and we will reply with a proposal. PLAYGROUND, s.r.o., Poštová 6562/20, Trnava.

services.name: Custom indoor playgrounds
services.description: Design, 3D visualisation, manufacture and turnkey installation for family centres, cafés, hotels, nurseries and water parks. Playgrounds meet EN 1176 and EN 1177.

services.name: Rebuilding old playgrounds
services.description: Rebuilding an old playground into a new, certified one, reusing steel from the original structure, joints and undamaged modules.

services.name: Playground relocation
services.description: Dismantling the playground, transport and installation in a new space, resized as needed.

services.name: Playground inspections and service
services.description: Annual inspections of indoor playgrounds, repairs and replacement of worn parts.

services.name: Inflatable attractions
services.description: Inflatable attractions for children as an addition to playgrounds. Types and prices depend on demand.
